review_findings: The transport supplies live read-only GitHub evidence to the existing deterministic onboarding evaluator and does not become a second readiness authority.
The endpoint allowlist is repository-bound and excludes every mutation and workflow-dispatch operation.
Environment secrets are handled only as names; values are never requested, accepted, persisted, hashed, or displayed.
Ambiguous authorization, pagination, content, identity, or digest failures fail closed instead of being interpreted as absent configuration.
The sealed artifact cannot start WP-08, authorize release, deploy, merge, or set production_closed.

skill_rule_mappings.assessment: the CLI delegates PASS/BLOCKED/FAIL to scripts/repository_onboarding_preflight.py unchanged
only bounded GitHub GET endpoints are exposed and all payload-selected routing is rejected
only unique secret names from the Environment listing endpoint enter the artifact
all outputs retain authority_effect=false, deploy_allowed=false, and production_closed=false
